observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && for u in "https://molochai.dev/pricing" "https://uplinkswitch.ai/pricing" "https://tartarusai.dev/pricing"; do echo "########## $u"; curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "$u" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
s=sys.stdin.read(); s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
s=re.sub(r'<(br|/p|/div|/li|/h[1-6]|/tr|/td)>','\n',s)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',t); t=re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+','\n',t)
print(t[:1100])
"; echo; done
